# Vulnerabilities present and accepted for now, one "package GHSA-id" per line.
#
# Each needs a semver range moved — a change with its own risk — or has no
# released fix. What is left is almost entirely *transitive*: a dependency
# pinning an old copy of something the root cannot move on its own. The
# OpenTelemetry entries are the clearest example — they arrive as a set pinned
# together by the package that uses them, and overriding one piece of a set
# breaks it. Those close when the package holding them updates.
#
# This is a list to shrink, and the check names entries that stop appearing so
# they can be deleted.
#
# Regenerated 2026-08-09 after pinning axios, undici, ws, dompurify, postcss,
# Regenerated 2026-08-09 after clearing the cheap critical advisories.
# Regenerated 2026-08-10 after the in-range refresh: 181 down to 71, none new.
# Regenerated 2026-08-10 after the major pass: 71 down to 43, none new. tar and
# multer are gone — multer crossed to 2.x, which is what its advisory wanted.
# Regenerated 2026-08-10 after the audit pass: 43 down to 29, none new. Fourteen
# entries had stopped appearing and were still being accepted, which is the one
# way this file can make things worse than having no file — happy-dom and
# langsmith left with the test stack and the langchain pins, qs / request /
# tough-cookie / prismjs with the transitive trees that held them.
# Regenerated 2026-09-11 after the September pass: 54 findings down to 19.
# multer, nodemailer, sharp and the tiptap family moved within their majors;
# same-major overrides closed fast-uri, hono, qs, svgo, mysql2, js-yaml 3 and 4,
# defu, h3, socket.io-parser and the last lodash 4.17 copy. Fourteen entries
# stopped appearing and are gone. Four new ones need a major the holder has not
# taken, and are accepted below with the path that brings them in.

@opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node GHSA-q7rr-3cgh-j5r3
@opentelemetry/core GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf

@opentelemetry/propagator-jaeger GHSA-45rx-2jwx-cxfr
@opentelemetry/sdk-node GHSA-q7rr-3cgh-j5r3
ai GHSA-rwvc-j5jr-mgvh
# query-string 7.1.3 pins decode-uri-component 0.2.2; the fix is 0.5, a line
# query-string 7 does not accept.
decode-uri-component GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr
# Prisma 7.9.1's own config loader pins deepmerge-ts 7; the fix is 8.
deepmerge-ts GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx
elliptic GHSA-848j-6mx2-7j84
esbuild GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr
file-type GHSA-5v7r-6r5c-r473
image-size GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq
image-size GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr
jsondiffpatch GHSA-33vc-wfww-vjfv
# ai 4 (a peer of @mastra/core's chat package) pins jsondiffpatch 0.6; the
# fix is 0.7, which ai 4 does not accept.
jsondiffpatch GHSA-j4fx-xxwh-2485
quill GHSA-v3m3-f69x-jf25
# @solana/web3.js 1.98 -> jayson 4 pins stream-json 1; the fix is 3. Reached
# only by the wallet sign-in.
stream-json GHSA-528h-pc64-c93x
uuid GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq
